Your home network, or your own server outside the house

By default the host is at home: Safeer Link runs on this TV and the files come from your computer in the same house - nothing leaves your network.\n\nYou can also use your own server outside the house (a rented or cloud machine). Then the TV connects to it over the internet: pairing is the same as at home (a code, and the certificate is pinned), but the traffic - including your files - leaves your home network and travels to that server. Only use a server you control.
Name or IP address, with a port if it is not the usual one. Example: moj-streznik.si or 203.0.113.7:8990
That does not look like an address. Example: moj-streznik.si
Safeer Link on that server shows a code. Type it here. The code never travels over the network; both sides only prove they know it.

The server did not answer. Check the address, that Safeer Link is running on it and that the port is open.
The host is %1$s, outside your home network. Go back to the home network? The token for that server is forgotten; you can pair again at any time.
The host is the home network again.

Safeer OS is switched on as the home screen, but this television does not hand the Home key over: the manufacturer routes it to its own home screen (%1$s). That is the TV\'s doing, not a fault in Safeer OS, and without changing the TV\'s firmware it cannot be worked around.\n\nSafeer OS still opens from the launcher, from the apps row and with the Safeer Link remote. You can leave this on (it costs nothing) or switch it off.
